Interface NamedValues

All Known Subinterfaces:
FormData, PathVariables
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultPathVariables, MatchedPathVariables, RoutePathVariables
public interface NamedValues
Named values of a request that convert to types: the PathVariables of the route it matched, or the text fields of its form. There are accessors for strings and the primitive types, e.g. getLong("id") or findInt("page"), with a default value for a missing value, e.g. getInt("page", 0). A missing required value or a value that does not convert is answered with 400.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
